authorization: Latest user task explicitly authorizes numerical robustness, additional independent development repeats, second-implementation audit and one final locked confirmation, including stable negative findings. This supersedes older conditional DO_NOT_RUN gates solely for a new frozen empirical confirmation; no online M3 is authorized or implied.
scientific_boundary: No new FP functional model, target objective, neural/RL model, search primitive or budget controller. Existing outputs immutable.

data_roles.development: original16 only for all technical choices
data_roles.exposed_validation: old12 not fresh confirmation, no new method selection
data_roles.locked20: remain unrun until one separate final protocol and executable/source/model artifacts frozen

stage1.scope: 112 original development nested-OOF fits, seven frozen feature arms A/B/C/D/E/N/P; exact original feature normalization and logistic objective
stage1.optimizer: independent analytic Newton with Armijo; no objective changes
stage1.sufficient_convergence: independently recomputed gradient infinity norm <=1e-7; finite loss/parameters and accepted descent
stage1.uniform_failure: Any fit failing numerical criterion remains FAILED; no FP-favorable iteration selection. A failed stage cannot certify a fully converged comparison or silently unlock testing.
stage1.independent_checks: separately accumulated objective/gradient and fixed-direction finite-difference derivative checks, mathematical same L2/n with unpenalized intercept
stage1.statistics: EvsC/N/P x AP/Brier/gain original nine-comparison layout; paired instance exact signed ranks +Holm, marginal instance->trajectory bootstrap10000seed20261019; clearly numerical robustness, not new independent confirmation
stage1.cost_estimate: 112 fits of16200 rows and max148 parameters, dense Newton typically8-20 steps; single-thread BLAS per task; estimated minutes to tens of minutes, <~500MB sequential; maximum200 fixed for every arm

stage2.sampling: all original development16 instances; run_index0..4; generations40,100,160,240states/80trajectories. Deterministic and no use of branch outcomes.
stage2.atomic_repeats: add repeats2..6, five new independent repeats, preserving original0/1; total7 per original action/state
stage2.work_control_repeats: five new independent repeats for each ofGA/LS/VND with common480 true objective-request ceiling
stage2.work_window: Repeat existing same-action calls on the evolving branch state until480 requests. GA=6 complete80-request generations, LS repeatedmaxiter100 plus normal returnverification, VND repeatedmaxiter100. Never interleave different actions. No artificial padding. Retain best evaluated incumbent at interruption.
stage2.natural_and_cap_rules: Record each original call natural return/capped, completed calls, actual queries/decodes/time. VND can finish479 if remaining1 is insufficient for its native minimum2requests; stop and disclose unused1. No empty-query fill. Exact work not claimed where actual differs.
stage2.scoring: frozen original and stage1 converged development-OOF probabilities; no retraining or new reward objective. Atomic-trained scores on480 mode are explicitly window-transfer stress tests, not models calibrated for that window.
stage2.repeat_inference: action-specific mean/variance/empirical uncertainty; within-state winner/tie behavior; old2-repeat oracle action evaluated on independent new5 (and leave-one-repeat ranking sensitivity); fixedactions andFP/NoFP paired gains, trajectory/instance grouping; all states retained

cost_estimate.estimated_wall: 1-3min plus I/O; conservative10min, estimate not observed runtime

stage2.primary_family: new atomic and480 windows x(EvsC/N/P selectedgain)=6 jointHolm comparisons on independent new5; AP/Brier/mechanism metrics descriptive. Instance->paired trajectory bootstrap10000seed20261020; original2 outcome labels do not enter new5 scores.
stage2.failure_rules: Keep runtime/interface/infeasible failures explicitly; no replacing states based on quality or eliminating no-improvement actions. Deterministic engineering defects may be fixed before formal batch with new source lock and without outcome-based model changes.

stage3: Bounded independent-implementation interface audit; separate protocol required if feasible. Parameter-only variants not counted.
stage4: Final protocol not yet frozen. No locked outcome may be collected until stages1/2 technical decisions and stage3 disposition complete, all prediction artifacts/executables fixed.
